# Thurrock Tuition Academy

> Small-group Maths, English and Science tuition in Grays, Thurrock, Essex.
> SATs, 11+, KS3, GCSE and A-Level. Every new student starts with a free
> two-hour assessment. Sessions are capped at eight students.

Thurrock Tuition Academy is a tutoring centre at Suite 1, Queensgate Centre,
Orsett Road, Grays, Thurrock, Essex. It serves families across the borough
including Tilbury, Chafford Hundred, Stanford-le-Hope, Corringham, South
Ockendon, Aveley, West Thurrock, Purfleet and Chadwell St Mary.

## Pages

- [Home](https://thurrocktuitionacademy.co.uk/): Overview, subjects, stages and parent FAQs.
- [Our tuition](https://thurrocktuitionacademy.co.uk/services): Programme detail per subject and stage, the six-step journey, and session pricing.
- [About](https://thurrocktuitionacademy.co.uk/about): Mission, vision, founder, values and history.
- [Contact and free assessment](https://thurrocktuitionacademy.co.uk/contact): Application form, FAQs, timetable and location.

## Key facts

- Subjects: Mathematics, English, Science (Biology, Chemistry, Physics).
- Stages: SATs (KS2), 11+ entrance exams, KS3, GCSE, A-Level Mathematics.
- Exam boards: AQA, Edexcel, OCR, Eduqas.
- Session length: two hours. Maximum eight students per session.
- Session fees: SATs £35-40, 11+ £40-45, KS3 £45-50, GCSE £50-60, A-Level Maths £70-80.
- First assessment is free and carries no obligation.
- Payment is on the day by cash or bank transfer. No contracts or minimum term.
- Opening hours: Monday to Saturday, 9am-6pm. Closed Sunday.
- Telephone: 07480 413679. Email: bookings@thurrocktuitionacademy.co.uk

## Notes

- Tutors are qualified teachers with enhanced DBS clearance.
- Photographs on the site are illustrative stock imagery, not photographs of
  the academy's premises, staff or students.
